Aurelia Skyways' Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed your complaint that the handling of your pet itinerary left you without clear support after a missed connection and then complicated the follow-up on the missing crate.

We understand the concern and regret that the experience did not reflect the careful guidance we aim to provide before departure. Our team expects prompt, respectful communication, and we also expect every case to be handled with clear explanations and steady updates so travelers know what to do next. In situations involving a missed connection, the standard payout is $125, and that amount is applied as the set payment for that service interruption. For a lost crate, the claim must be filed within 78 days, which is the filing period for that type of report.

Please note that our safety coordinator reviews the conditions that can affect animal travel and works to reduce preventable risks before departure. That review includes crate handling, transfer timing, and the steps that follow irregular operations. When a traveler raises a concern, the Companion Animal Travel Desk records the report, checks the available history, and responds with instructions that match the situation. If any part of the process was unclear in your case, we apologize and will use your complaint to improve the clarity of our written guidance and the consistency of our replies.

If you are still waiting for a status update, continue to keep your records available and submit any remaining documents without delay. Clear communication helps us confirm the details, evaluate the service event, and close the file without unnecessary back-and-forth. We also encourage travelers to contact the desk before departure whenever they have concerns about pet transfer arrangements, because early questions allow us to address hazards and prevention steps in a direct way.

Aurelia Skyways values the trust placed in us when a pet travels under our care. We regret any frustration caused by this matter and appreciate the chance to correct the record and improve future service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
